Yandex Data Centre in Russia Disrupted by Drone Attack

Yandex's data centre located in the Vladimir region of Russia experienced operational disruptions following a drone attack. The incident affected the facility's operations, leading to its temporary shutdown. This event marks the second major data centre in Russia to be targeted by what are described as Ukrainian drones.
